def f(g):
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0]); res=[r[:] for r in g]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            v=g[i][j]
            if v==1: continue
            d=j-i
            k=-1
            while True:
                rr,cc=i+k,j+d-k
                if not (0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w): break
                res[rr][cc]=v; k-=1
            k=1
            while True:
                rr,cc=i+k,j+d+k
                if not (0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w): break
                res[rr][cc]=v; k+=1
    return res

import os,re,json
from collections import defaultdict
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])

import os,re,json

from collections import Counter, defaultdict
def f(inp):
    h=len(inp); w=len(inp[0]); out=[row[:] for row in inp]
    bg=Counter(x for row in inp for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    pts=defaultdict(list)
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if inp[r][c]!=bg: pts[inp[r][c]].append((r,c))
    segs=[]; used=set()
    for col,ps in sorted(pts.items()):
        ps=list(set(ps))
        best=None
        for i,a in enumerate(ps):
            if a in used: continue
            for b in ps[i+1:]:
                if b in used: continue
                d=a[0]-b[0]; dc=a[1]-b[1]
                if abs(d)==abs(dc):
                    lo=min(a,b); hi=max(a,b)
                    g=hi[0]-lo[0]
                    cells=[(lo[0]+k, lo[1]+k*(hi[1]-lo[1])//g) for k in range(g+1)]
                    if best is None or len(cells)>len(best): best=cells
            if best is None: break
        if best is None: continue
        cells=best
        used|=set(cells)
        typ='main' if cells[-1][1]>cells[0][1] else 'anti'
        segs.append((col,typ,cells))
    # draw segments on bg only
    for col,typ,cells in segs:
        for r,c in cells:
            if inp[r][c]==bg: out[r][c]=col
    # extend every marker on the segment's line, perpendicular direction, filling bg
    for col,typ,cells in segs:
        ld=cells[0][0]-cells[0][1] if typ=='main' else None
        ls=cells[0][0]+cells[0][1] if typ=='anti' else None
        for r in range(h):
            for c in range(w):
                if inp[r][c]==bg: continue
                on = typ=='main' and (r-c==ld) or typ=='anti' and (r+c==ls)
                if not on: continue
                oth=inp[r][c]
                if typ=='main':      # perpendicular = anti-diagonal lines through (r,c): rr+c = r+c
                    for cc in range(w):
                        rr=(r+c)-cc
                        if 0<=rr<h and inp[rr][cc]==bg: out[rr][cc]=oth
                else:                # perpendicular = main-diagonal lines: rr-c = r-c
                    for rr in range(h):
                        cc=(r-c)+rr
                        if 0<=cc<w and inp[rr][cc]==bg: out[rr][cc]=oth
    return out
allok=True
for n in range(1,6):
    inp=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; out=f(inp); e=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    ok_=out==e; allok&=ok_
    print(n, ok_, [(r,c,out[r][c],e[r][c]) for r in range(len(e)) for c in range(len(e[0])) if out[r][c]!=e[r][c]][:8])
print('ALL OK' if allok else 'MISMATCH')

def f(g):
    h=len(g);w=len(g[0])
    bgv=Counter(x for row in g for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    D=lambda rr,cc:rr-cc; A=lambda rr,cc:rr+cc
    marks=[(r,c,g[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]!=bgv]
    # step: for each color, sort its markers; draw straight segments between consecutive ones (along their shared diag or otherwise) filling bg
    for v in sorted(set(m[2] for m in marks)):
        pts=sorted((r,c) for r,c,x in marks if x==v)
        for i in range(len(pts)-1):
            r0,c0=pts[i]; r1,c1=pts[i+1]
            dr,dc=r1-r0,c1-c0
            gcd_=math.gcd(abs(dr),abs(dc)); dr//=gcd_; dc//=gcd_
            # only connect if collinear with a diagonal (|dr|==|dc|)
            if abs(dr)!=abs(dc) or not (abs(dr)==1 or True):
                continue
            for s in range(1,abs(dr)+1):
                r,c=r0+s*dr,c0+s*dc
                if 0<=c<w and g[r][c]==bgv: out[r][c]=v
    return out
print([f(G[f'Demo pair {n} input'])==G[f'Demo pair {n} output'] for n in range(1,6)])

for n in range(1,6):
    inp=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; exp=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    h=len(inp);w=len(inp[0])
    bgv=Counter(x for row in inp for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    D=lambda rr,cc:rr-cc; A=lambda rr,cc:rr+cc
    marks=[(r,c,inp[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if inp[r][c]!=bgv]
    adds={p for p in [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)] if exp[p[0]][p[1]]!=inp[p[0]][p[1]]}
    print(f"==demo{n}")
    # group adds by their own diagonals
    byD=defaultdict(list); byA=defaultdict(list)
    for r,c in adds:
        byD[D(r,c)].append((r,c,exp[r][c]))
        byA[A(r,c)].append((r,c,exp[r][c]))
    print(' adds on D:',{k:v for k,v in sorted(byD.items())})
    print(' adds on A:',{k:v for k,v in sorted(byA.items())})
    print(' markers:',marks)

def analyze(n):
    inp=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; exp=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    h=len(inp);w=len(inp[0])
    bgv=Counter(x for row in inp for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    D=lambda rr,cc:rr-cc; A=lambda rr,cc:rr+cc
    marks=[(r,c,inp[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if inp[r][c]!=bgv]
    adds=[(r,c,exp[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if exp[r][c]!=inp[r][c] and inp[r][c]==bgv]
    return inp,exp,h,w,bgv,marks,adds,D,A
for n in [2,3]:
    inp,exp,h,w,bgv,marks,adds,D,A=analyze(n)
    print(f"==demo{n}: markers:",[(r,c,v) for r,c,v in marks])
    print("   fills:",[(r,c,v) for r,c,v in adds])
    # what diagonals do the fills share?
    Df=set(D(r,c) for r,c,v in adds); Af=set(A(r,c) for r,c,v in adds)
    print(' fill diag types:',Df,'|',Af)

def load():

    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}

        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]

def diagfills(n):
    inp=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; exp=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    h=len(inp);w=len(inp[0])
    bgv=Counter(x for row in inp for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    D=lambda r,c:r-c; A=lambda r,c:r+c
    marks=sorted([(r,c,inp[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if inp[r][c]!=bgv])
    print(f"==demo{n}")
    byD=defaultdict(list); byA=defaultdict(list)
    for r,c,v in marks: byD[D(r,c)].append((r,c,v)); byA[A(r,c)].append((r,c,v))
    # all fills with orientation & marker presence on that line (any color count)
    fills=[(r,c,exp[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if exp[r][c]!=inp[r][c] and inp[r][c]==bgv]
    for r,c,v in fills:
        tD=D(r,c); tA=A(r,c)
        cntD=len(byD[tD]); cntA=len(byA[tA])
        print('  fill',(r,c),v,'on D%d (%d markers)'%tD if 'D' in str(type(tD)) else '', ' / A%d (%d markers)'%tA, '| dcount=%d, acount=%d'%(cntD,cntA))
# careful: D/A are lambdas in local; fine. Print compactly.
for n in range(1,6):
    inp=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; exp=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    h=len(inp);w=len(inp[0])
    bgv=Counter(x for row in inp for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    D=lambda a,b:a-b; A=lambda a,b:a+b
    marks=[(r,c,inp[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if inp[r][c]!=bgv]
    byD=defaultdict(list); byA=defaultdict(list)
    for r,c,v in marks: byD[D(r,c)].append(v); byA[A(r,c)].append(v)
    print(f"==demo{n}: byD sizes:", {k:len(v) for k,v in sorted(byD.items())}, "byA:",{k:len(v) for k,v in sorted(byA.items())})

def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

    gi=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; go=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']

    ch=[(r,c,gi[r][c],go[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if gi[r][c]!=go[r][c]]
    print('== pair',n,'bg=',bgv,'markers:',marks)

def f(g):
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    bgv=Counter(x for row in g for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    def kv(p,dp): return p[0]-p[1] if dp=='D' else p[0]+p[1]
    cnt={}
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if g[r][c]!=bgv: cnt.setdefault(g[r][c],[]).append((r,c))
    out=[list(row) for row in g]
    fills={}  # pos -> diag line set
    # collect fills: for each marker, partner diagonals
    allmarks=[]
    for col,pts in sorted(cnt.items()): allmarks+=[(col,p) for p in pts]
    for col,p in allmarks:
        pr=[pc for cc,pc in allmarks if cc!=col and (kv(pc,'D')==kv(p,'D') or kv(pc,'A')==kv(p,'A'))]
        if not pr: continue
        # perpendicular fill
        perps = [ 'A' if kv(p,'D')==kv(pr[0],'D') else 'D']
        perpd = 'A' if kv(p,'D')==kv(pr[0],'D') else 'D'
        ik = kv(p,perpd)
        for rr in range(h):
            cc=rr-ik if perpd=='D' else ik-rr
            if 0<=cc<w and out[rr][cc]==bgv: out[rr][cc]=col
    return out

def f(g):
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    bgv=Counter(x for row in g for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    def kv(p,dp): return p[0]-p[1] if dp=='D' else p[0]+p[1]
    pts=[(r,c,g[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]!=bgv]
    out=[list(row) for row in g]
    # groups per diagonal
    dd=defaultdict(list)
    da=defaultdict(list)
    for r,c,col in pts:
        dd[r-c].append((r,c,col)); da[r+c].append((r,c,col))
    # pass 1: >=2 same-color on a diag -> fill segment (bg only)
    for grp,lines in (('dd',dd),('da',da)):
        for k,v in lines.items():
            n=len(v)
            if n<2: continue
            cs={x[2] for x in v}
            if len(cs)!=1: continue
            col=v[0][2]
            lo=min(p[0] for p in v); hi=max(p[0] for p in v)
            for r in range(lo,hi+1):
                c=r-k if grp=='dd' else k-r
                if 0<=c<w and out[r][c]==bgv: out[r][c]=col
    # pass 2: marker on a diag (either orientation) that holds >=2 markers of another color -> fill its own perpendicular diag fully (bg only)
    for grp,lines in (('dd',dd),('da',da)):
        for k,v in lines.items():
            if len(v)<2: continue
            cols=[x[2] for x in v]
            other=[c for c in set(cols) if cols.count(c)<len(v)]
            if not other: continue
            other_col=other[0]
            for r,c,col in v:
                if col==other_col: continue
                # perpendicular diag through (r,c)
                if grp=='dd': dp='A'; ik=r+c
                else: dp='D'; ik=r-c
                for rr in range(h):
                    cc=ik-rr if dp=='A' else rr-ik
                    if 0<=cc<w and out[rr][cc]==bgv: out[rr][cc]=col
    return out
print([f(G[f'Demo pair {n} input'])==G[f'Demo pair {n} output'] for n in range(1,6)])

def f(g, mode='endcolor'):
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    bgv=Counter(x for row in g for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[list(row) for row in g]
    dd=defaultdict(list);da=defaultdict(list)
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if g[r][c]!=bgv:
                dd[r-c].append((r,c,g[r][c])); da[r+c].append((r,c,g[r][c]))
    # pass 1: per line with >=2 markers, fill span between extremes with endpoint color (bg only)
    for L,lines in (('D',dd),('A',da)):
        for k,v in lines.items():
            lo=min(p[0] for p in v); hi=max(p[0] for p in v)
            if len(v)<2: continue
            ends=[x[2] for x in v if x[0]==lo or x[0]==hi]
            col=ends[0] if len(set(ends))==1 else None
            if col is None: continue
            for r in range(lo,hi+1):
                c=r-k if L=='D' else k-r
                if 0<=c<w and out[r][c]==bgv: out[r][c]=col
    # pass 2: markers on lines with >=2 markers -> fill perpendicular fully (bg only), skip if their parallel line has >=2 same-color
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if g[r][c]==bgv: continue
            col=g[r][c]
            n_d=sum(1 for rr in range(h) for cc in range(w) if rr-cc==r-c and (rr,cc)!=(r,c) and g[rr][cc]!=bgv)
            n_a=sum(1 for rr in range(h) for cc in range(w) if rr+cc==r+c and (rr,cc)!=(r,c) and g[rr][cc]!=bgv)
            inmulti = n_d>=1 or n_a>=1
            if not inmulti: continue
            # skip if their own line has >=2 of the same color (they're part of a same-color group)
            same_d=sum(1 for rr in range(h) for cc in range(w) if rr-cc==r-c and (rr,cc)!=(r,c) and g[rr][cc]==col)
            same_a=sum(1 for rr in range(h) for cc in range(w) if rr+cc==r+c and (rr,cc)!=(r,c) and g[rr][cc]==col)
            if same_d>=1 or same_a>=1: continue
            for L in ('D','A'):
                ik=r-c if L=='D' else r+c
                for rr in range(h):
                    cc=rr-ik if L=='D' else ik-rr
                    if 0<=cc<w and out[rr][cc]==bgv: out[rr][cc]=col
    return out
print([f(G[f'Demo pair {n} input'])==G[f'Demo pair {n} output'] for n in range(1,6)])
